# SI002 — multiple-or-zero-contract-classes

Exactly one contract class must be defined per file.

## Why

The CLI, schema extraction, and deployment registry assume one deployable contract per source file.

## Bad

```python
class A(gl.Contract): ...
class B(gl.Contract): ...
```

## Good

```python
class SafetyNet(gl.Contract): ...
```

## Suppression

```python
# safetynet-disable-next-line SI002 -- reason
```
